title: Go SDK: cancellable streaming guard with soft-deadline smoothing and backpressure-aware retries
creator: Samir Patel
description: Implement a streaming helper for the Go SDK that smooths sharp context cancellations into soft deadlines, coordinates backpressure-aware retry windows, and exposes ergonomic primitives for client code to observe cancellation vs transient timeouts. This ticket covers design, implementation, tests, and integration with the runtime's metrics and logging hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Client code can set a soft-deadline window (e.g., 200ms before ctx.Deadline()) and receive an OnSoftDeadline callback
SDK preemptively reduces prefetch/concurrency during soft-deadline windows to avoid tail latency spikes
Retries triggered by transient errors during soft-deadline windows are suppressed unless explicitly allowed
Unit and integration tests simulate context cancellations, deadline shifts, and backpressure; test coverage >= 85% for new packages
Provide docs and two examples: (1) resumable streaming consumer, (2) low-latency short-lived request pattern
comments: 2025-02-10 - Samir: Spiked design choices; prefer a middleware-style 'StreamingGuard' to allow opt-in behavior per stream. See design notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/stream-guard-design
2025-02-11 - Elena: Reviewed spike; asked to define metrics (soft_deadline_enter, soft_deadline_exit, suppressed_retries).

2025-02-12 - Eng sync: Decided to implement soft-deadline as relative jittered window (default 10% of remaining time capped at 250ms) to avoid pathological trimming. Trade-off: may be conservative for very short deadlines.
2025-02-12 - PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/824 — initial implementation and unit tests
2025-02-13 - Code review (J. Nguyen): Suggested separating policy config from runtime guard to allow runtime toggles per-customer. Added comment to PR.

2025-02-14 - Integration test: found race where stream prefetcher doesn't observe updated deadline; fixed by adding atomic deadline snapshot. Added integration PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/831
